takes.text: Chỉ sau một lúc, hàng loạt cái tên xuất hiện… Áo tứ thân. Áo ngũ thân. Nhật Bình. Áo bà ba…
takes.style: Scene: At home in the evening, Tí searches on a laptop and a flood of garment names appears; Tèo leans in, asking which region one belongs to. Tí feels small. Speaker: the storyteller of this film, a warm Vietnamese man around forty; calm, unhurried, intimate, never theatrical. Delivery: Rising wonder, as a flood of new names appears on a screen. Then: Say only the name, clearly, like reading a label; slight wonder. Then: Say only the name, clearly, a beat faster. Then: Say only the name, clearly, a beat faster. Then: Say only the name, trailing off as the list keeps going. Speak Vietnamese with a natural Northern accent. Leave a short natural pause between sentences.

Scene: At home in the evening, Tí searches on a laptop and a flood of garment names appears; Tèo leans in, asking which region one belongs to. Tí feels small. Speaker: Tèo, Tí's thoughtful 13-year-old best friend with glasses; calm, curious, speaks a little slower, gently amused. Delivery: Pointing at the screen, curious and a little teasing. Speak Vietnamese with a natural Northern accent. Leave a short natural pause between sentences.

Scene: At home in the evening, Tí searches on a laptop and a flood of garment names appears; Tèo leans in, asking which region one belongs to. Tí feels small. Speaker: Tí, a lively 13-year-old Vietnamese boy; quick and playful, a little cocky; when unsure he slows down and hesitates but stays clearly audible. Delivery: Small and embarrassed, quiet admission after a pause. Speak Vietnamese with a natural Northern accent. Leave a short natural pause between sentences.
